name: Runaway
description: Runaway is a self-hosted orchestrator for ephemeral GitHub Actions runners. It watches your GitHub orgs for queued jobs and scales Docker-based runner pools on machines you already own, down to zero when idle.

app_vars.name: var_runaway_repo
app_vars.label: Runaway Repository URL
app_vars.help: Git URL of the Runaway repository from the official quickstart

notes.text: Run this addon inside an existing Debian LXC with nesting enabled, such as the Docker LXC. Runaway starts runner containers through Docker, so it is installed as a Docker Compose stack.
Create your admin account on first access, then add a GitHub org with a classic PAT and create a scale set.
Runaway is licensed under BSL 1.1 (each release converts to Apache 2.0). Check the license before commercial use.
